name: Spare the Dying
summary: A cantrip that stabilizes a creature at 0 Hit Points.

stats.effect: Choose a creature within range that has 0 {ref:glossary/hit-points} and isn't dead. The creature becomes {ref:glossary/stable}.
stats.cantripUpgrade: The range doubles when you reach levels 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet), and 17 (120 feet).
